st: Forget Pif: we are the aliens — a reflection on travel, Western privilege and statistical anomaly, inspired by a trip to India and Nepal.

sec.p: Forget Pif: we are the aliens. A trip to India and Nepal reveals how much European normality is an exception on a global scale. Running water, stable electricity, breathable air: they aren't 'the bare minimum', they're a statistical privilege. Out of 8 billion people, the…

Travel isn't tourism: it's cognitive recalibration. When infrastructure disappears, the biological assumptions emerge — air, water, sun — that Western comfort makes invisible. The encounter with India forces a review of priorities: our Wi-Fi anxiety shrinks in front of people…
